wire.t: Week 9 final: 50 Shades of Rae 203.26 over Hanging with Hernandez 65.66, Lemon Squeezy 139.06 over Picken Weiners 115.58, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 165.80 over Trevor Have I Ever 137.98, Young Love Hunters 109.88 over I Believe in Love 77.90, Mean Machine 119.24 over Chubb So Big I Waddle 97.06, and Prepetente is the GOAT! 95.78 over Hurts So Good 95.30.
Prepetente is the GOAT! beat Hurts So Good by 0.48, the closest game of 2026. Marco_Polo left Kayshon Boutte (29.50) on the bench and MakeItRains left Darren Waller (23.00) on his.
Young Love Hunters won for the first time in 2026, 109.88 to 77.90 over I Believe in Love. Jordan Love scored 40.18, the top starter score of the week. BeatULikeABoss is 1-8.

Four teams are on bye in Week 10: the Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers. Bill_Buttlicker (D'Andre Swift), superdog91 (Bucky Irving), BertDirty (Luther Burden III) and RobMeyers (Caleb Williams) all lose a top scorer.
Jaylen Waddle is in the concussion protocol after a high-low hit, and Denver's bye gives him extra recovery time. RobMeyers owns Waddle, who has 85.00 points this season.
Puka Nacua has a knee injury with early optimism that the ACL is intact, with imaging ordered to check for meniscus and soft-tissue damage. superdog91 owns Nacua, who scored 35.00 in Week 9.
Jeremiyah Love was placed on injured reserve with a recurring ankle injury and is guaranteed to miss at least four games. Buccaneer51 owns Love, who is already on his IR.
No trades since Sept. 17 in the Sleeper log. The trade deadline is Week 13, so the next move has to come soon.

stories.title: Prepetente is the GOAT! beats Hurts So Good by 0.48, and 50 Shades of Rae drops 203.26
stories.dek: The closest game of the year, the biggest blowout of the year (+137.60), and a winless team that finally isn't.
body: Prepetente is the GOAT! 95.78, Hurts So Good 95.30. That's a 0.48-point game, the closest of 2026 (the old mark was 0.94 in Week 3). Brock Purdy gave Marco_Polo 25.28 at quarterback, and he still left Kayshon Boutte's 29.50 on the bench. MakeItRains left Darren Waller's 23.00 on the pine while Greg Dulcich started at FLEX for 3.40. Either of those moves flips a game decided by less than a point, and one of them did flip it.

50 Shades of Rae hung 203.26 on Hanging with Hernandez, who scored 65.66, the lowest score of the week. The 137.60-point margin is the biggest of the season (the old mark was 113.42 in Week 7). Puka Nacua had 35.00, Christian Watson 31.10, Bucky Irving 28.50 and Bijan Robinson 26.70 for superdog91, who is 7-2 and second in points.

Elsewhere: Lemon Squeezy beat Picken Weiners 139.06 to 115.58 and is 8-1, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 beat Trevor Have I Ever 165.80 to 137.98 on Kenneth Walker III (36.30) and CeeDee Lamb (35.50), Mean Machine beat Chubb So Big I Waddle 119.24 to 97.06 behind Joe Burrow's 31.54, and Young Love Hunters got its first win. TotesMagoat's 155.88 bench total takes the Week 9 bench payout.

stories.title: Young Love Hunters gets win No. 1: 109.88 on Jordan Love's 40.18, and it's 1‑8
stories.dek: BeatULikeABoss ended the 0‑8 with a 31.98-point win over I Believe in Love.
body: Young Love Hunters 109.88, I Believe in Love 77.90. Jordan Love scored 40.18, the biggest starter score in the whole league this week, Audric Estime added 14.70 and the Packers defense 13.00. It's the first win of 2026 for BeatULikeABoss, who came in 0-8 with an all-play record of 0-88 and is now 5-94 in all-play after beating five teams on points alone.

On the other side, Buccaneer51 started Jared Goff (5.30), Ladd McConkey (0.00) and the Vikings defense (6.00) and left 38.18 on the bench, including SF defense at 19.00 and Bo Nix at 15.68. I Believe in Love is 5-4, has the fewest points of any team with a winning record (949.24), and is out of the top six on the tiebreak.
Dynasty note: Young Love Hunters has the youngest core in the league (24.7) and three firsts across the next three drafts. A first win doesn't change the plan. The plan is still a top pick.

columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Three Rules For Surviving A Bye Week
columns.dek: The Bears, Broncos, Eagles and Buccaneers are off. I have a plan.
body: 1. Start the guy on bye. He's rested, and a rested player scores more than a tired one. D'Andre Swift is off this week, which means he'll be at full strength for Week 11.
2. Never trade for a replacement. Bill_Buttlicker has Swift (153.80 points) and a whole roster behind him, and the best replacement is the one already on your team who isn't playing.
3. Trust the schedule. RobMeyers has Caleb Williams on bye, which is the perfect time to find out whether Shedeur Sanders (24.68 on his bench last week) can do it twice.

columns.title: A 0.48-point game is 0.5% of the winner's score, which my model calls a tie
columns.dek: Prepetente is the GOAT! won 95.78 to 95.30 and my spreadsheet is furious.
body: Prepetente is the GOAT! scored 95.78. The margin was 0.48, which is 0.50% of that score. My 'Photo Finish Index' calls anything under 1% a tie and awards both teams a win, which is why my spreadsheet shows seven wins in a six-game week.

50 Shades of Rae scored 203.26 and Hanging with Hernandez scored 65.66. Divide one by the other and you get 3.10, which my model calls 'the Hernandez Ratio.' I made that up. It still doesn't mean anything.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.
